about:
Industrial Electronics Services LLC (IES) was founded in 1989 by Kathy and Larry Mullins in Gray, Tennessee. The couple established the company on two principles: delivering top-quality products and providing superior customer service. It remains a privately held business headquartered in Gray.

IES operates as a full-service electronic manufacturing services (EMS) provider from a facility exceeding 50,000 square feet with a staff of over 80. Its capabilities span surface-mount technology (SMT) with automated high-speed lines placing components as small as 01005, selective and manual soldering (leaded and lead-free), in-circuit, flying-probe, functional, X-ray, and AOI testing, conformal coating (silicone, acrylic, polyurethane), box-build assembly including cable harnesses and complex electro-mechanical integration, prototyping and new-product introduction, supply-chain management, and distribution. The company also runs an on-site IPC training center for J-STD-001 and IPC-A-610.

The company serves military, aerospace, energy, transportation, medical, communications, and industrial markets. Customers include defense and aerospace programs requiring ITAR compliance and IPC Class III workmanship, as well as medical-device manufacturers needing FDA cGMP-compliant production.

The founders' original commitment to quality and customer service continues to drive the business. IES emphasizes first-pass yield, on-time delivery, and a collaborative approach that integrates design-for-manufacturability, testability, and procurement support from prototype through volume production.
